column3: MT 40:29. Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “with” in “as with a bird.”
MT 40:30. Close to the Hebrew; “partners” is rendered “the traders.”
MT 41:1. The Hebrew has “his hope,” rendered “your expectation.”
MT 41:3. “Who has confronted Me” is rendered “Who has given to Me.”
MT 41:5. “The surface of his clothing” is rendered “his outer armor,” and “the doubling of his bridle” as “his double mail.”
MT 41:7. “Pride is the rows of shields” is rendered “His strong scales are his pride.”
MT 41:8. Close to the Hebrew; “breath” is rendered “air.”
MT 41:11. Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “burning” before “torches.”
MT 41:12. “A pot blown upon and bulrushes” is rendered “a boiling pot and burning rushes.”
MT 41:18. Close to the Hebrew; “it does not stand” is rendered “cannot avail.”
MT 41:20. “The son of a bow” is rendered “The arrow,” and “chaff” as “stubble.”
MT 41:22. “Under him” is rendered “His underparts,” and NASB supplies “like” before “a threshing sledge.”
